claims: The Artemis 2 rocket is known as the Space Launch System (SLS).
Northrop Grumman provided the solid rocket boosters.
United Launch Alliance built the Interim Cryogenic Propulsion System upper stage.
The core stage was developed at NASA's Michoud Assembly Facility.
The core stage is the largest part of the rocket.
The core stage features four RS-25 engines.
The solid rocket boosters are 5-segment solid rocket boosters derived from the Space Shuttle program.
The Interim Cryogenic Propulsion System (ICPS) provides the final push to the Moon.
Aerojet Rocketdyne built the RS-25 engines for the core stage.
Lockheed Martin built the crew capsule for Artemis 2.
The Orion spacecraft will carry the crew during the Artemis II mission.
